description.content:
Returns all the messages for all the private conversations for the context user. Also used to search across all messages and post a message.
To return all private conversations for the context user, see User Conversations, General.

https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.chatterapi.meta/chatterapi/connect_resources_users_messages_general.htm

info.name: Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 Abort Messages API

description.content:
Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 is a simplified, REST-based interface for bulk data operations that improves on the original Bulk API. It uses a straightforward job model and supports CSV format for ingest and query jobs, enabling processing of millions of records asynchronously.
